notes: MetricSpace needed no new import in tolerance.rs: the existing `use crate::cgmath64::*;` already re-exports cgmath::prelude::*, which re-exports structure::*, where MetricSpace is defined. cgmath 0.18 implements MetricSpace for PointN<S: BaseFloat> with Metric = S (point.rs:157), so Point2<f64> and Point3<f64> both satisfy `MetricSpace<Metric = f64>` as the packet assumed; no SPEC_GAP. One surprise: in cgmath 0.18 MetricSpace::distance takes self/other by value (not references), so `a.distance(b)` compiles exactly as written. Added length_margin (tau_rep * model_scale), ratio_margin (tau_rep), and generic near_points; near_pt, sin_margin and everything else untouched. Three tests appended (tests count 8 -> 11); one-sided test asserts the far-below-t0 disagreement explicitly. All four Done-when commands pass; workspace check reports one pre-existing unused_qualifications warning in truck-meshalgo/triangulation.rs, unrelated to this change.
